snippet.title: Stay in your Lane - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Stay in Your Lane on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5040850/Stay_in_Your_Lane/

The demo is coming soon to Steam!

Stay in Your Lane is a single-lane real-time strategy game about pressure, timing, and building the right army to break through.

Build your economy, unlock units, spells, and upgrades, then watch your strategy collide with the enemy’s. Play through the campaign, battle the AI in skirmish mode, or challenge another player online in 1v1.

Join the Discord:
https://discord.gg/kzZagP3aK

Keep moving. Hold the lane.

#StayInYourLane #IndieGame #StrategyGame #RTS #Steam
